name: Knott's Boardwalk BBQ Roasted Sweet Corn on the Cob (Indigestible Hull Warning)
whyItWorks: Whole sweet corn on the cob has tough outer cellulose hulls that cannot be digested. In stricturing Crohn's, whole corn kernels frequently cause complete mechanical bowel obstructions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trigger warning item: absolute avoid for stricturing Crohn's disease and active flares. Substitute cornbread muffins or mashed potatoes.
watchOuts: Insoluble corn hulls pass undigested and can block narrowed intestines
